text:
incident-bot: [P1] Notos (enterprise, vpc-nyc-dedicated) - elevated 5xx rate on us-east-1 endpoint, auto-escalation triggered. Paging oncall-anna :rotating_light:

oncall-anna: got the page, looking. seeing ~18% 5xx on /generate from Notos prod pool. latency up ~300ms. tagging in SRE.

sre-raj: ack. pulling metrics and leaderboards. checking dedicated pool health. can you confirm this is only us-east-1?

oncall-anna: so far yes. other regions normal. Notos reports increased client retries.

support-zoe: Notos support pinged. they see errors from their EU edge -> routing via our us-east backend. They asked if we can fail them to us-west as mitigation.

eng-runtime-maya: quick note: Notos is pinned to a dedicated pool in us-east-1 but we have warm capacity in us-west-2. We can route traffic to a compatible model variant with a custom routing policy. Need approval for DNS cutover + temporary override.

ops-coordinator-emma: timeline and mitigation options?

eng-lead-mike: options (fast -> slow):
• live-routing override at our load balancer to route Notos to us-west warm pool (no DNS change) — quickest, bounded risk
• DNS TTL cut + zone update to Notos customer CNAME -> us-west (requires client respect TTL)
• full tenant evacuation (drain + re-create sessions) — safest but longest

netops-lucas: we can push a backend routing override right away. I can do it with a canary for 5% traffic, monitor, then 50% then 100%.

notos_oncall: Notos SRE here. We're seeing client-side backoffs but can tolerate short redirect. Prefer non-DNS (LB-level) if you can keep session affinity. Also keep existing keys and telemetry intact.

oncall-anna: requirement: preserve KV cache affinity where possible to avoid cold-start regressions. eng-runtime-maya, can we map KV caches across pools?

eng-runtime-maya: KV cache not cross-region. We'll warm the model in us-west and prime caches with a replay of recent prefixes from the Notos session tail. That will reduce cold token regen. Takes ~12 mins to warm to steady state for active user patterns.

ops-coordinator-emma: decision: do LB-level canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% routing override to us-west warm pool, while weprep caches. Notify Notos and start canary.

netops-lucas: scheduling canary now. pushing route rule: 
```
route override apply --tenant notos --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 5 --preserve-affinity
```

netops-lucas: done. 5% diverted. metrics: 5xx for diverted traffic = 0.6%, for remaining us-east = 17.9%.

support-zoe: Notos acknowledges 5% diversion, seeing fewer retries on diverted sessions. :thumbsup:

oncall-anna: increase to 25% in 3m if stable. watching CPU/GPU saturation on us-west warm nodes.

eng-runtime-maya: warming scripts running. priming KV prefixes against a snapshot. priming progress: 40% after 4m.

netops-lucas: 25% pushed. rule now: 25% -> us-west.

incident-bot: deploy-checklist: CPU in us-west at 56% (OK), token latency median +40ms vs baseline, 5xx 0.5% on diverted. No errors observed on route metadata.

notos_oncall: diverted sessions show restored behaviour, few client retries. keep going.

oncall-anna: pushing to 60% now. please watch heatmaps for KV eviction.

netops-lucas: 60% applied. us-east 5xx dropped to 3.2%. us-west GPU memory per pod trending up; we'll add one more warm instance.

eng-runtime-maya: adding warm replica and rebalancing cache priming.

eng-lead-mike: quick ask: do we want to change DNS TTL now to accelerate full cutover if routing override doesn't hold?

support-zoe: Notos prefers LB routing for now. they warned about client DNS caching causing split behaviour.

notos_oncall: confirm we do NOT want DNS change yet. we rely on signed session tokens; load balancer override preserves them.

ops-coordinator-emma: agreed. continue LB override to 100%. schedule a simulated failback window in case issues.

netops-lucas: applying 100% now. finalizing route: 
```
route override apply --tenant notos --to us-west-2 --percent 100 --preserve-affinity --note "emergency divert due to us-east elevated 5xx"
```

netops-lucas: applied. all Notos traffic to us-west.

incident-bot: Alert: Spillover CPU in us-west reached 78% for 1m, autoscaler kicked, added 2 pods. 5xx now 0.3%.

oncall-anna: monitoring sess continuity. any session loss reports?

notos_oncall: clients report normal behaviour, slight latency bump (~55ms) but acceptable. Thanks for the quick action.

eng-runtime-maya: cache priming completed. cold-start token count down to baseline. hooking up tracing to verify model variant compatibility.

sre-raj: we need to capture post-switch data: request distribution, error rates, token cost diff, and KV miss rates. tagging for redwood-internal SLO postmortem.

eng-lead-mike: assign a short postmortem. ops-emma, can you coordinate with Notos to schedule a 1hr war-room after this stabilizes for a full RCA?

ops-coordinator-emma: will do. emailing Notos SRE to schedule for next 2 hours.

support-zoe: Customer impact summary for Notos: brief increase in errors for ~18 minutes before canary; full restoration via LB routing; no data loss; sessions preserved; commercial SLA impact expected: <1% of requests impacted. I'll file the customer-facing incident note.

incident-bot: note created: INC-2971234567-summary (assigned to support-zoe).

netops-lucas: planned maintenance: keep us-west warm replicas for 24h, don't revert route until postmortem and Notos signoff.

notos_oncall: we request a follow-up on root cause: why us-east pool degraded — may be noisy neighbor or infra issue. We'll provide logs.

sre-raj: capturing full kernel/driver logs and scheduler events from us-east. Eng-runtime-maya, any runtime regressions on the us-east cluster?

eng-runtime-maya: seeing elevated queue latency and a handful of OOM kills on older kernel. We'll correlate with driver patch from this morning. tagging eng-infra.

eng-lead-mike: escalate to eng-infra on the driver patch timeline. If patch correlated, schedule immediate rollback in us-east after we stabilize Notos.

ops-coordinator-emma: passing handoff to eng-sre rotation for overnight monitoring: oncall-anna -> sre-raj for incident watch.

oncall-anna: handing off. I remain available.

sre-raj: taking watch. I will keep the LB override in place, monitor autoscaling, and coordinate with eng-infra on the us-east root cause.

incident-bot: update: last_message_ts=2971236830. thread set to monitored by eng-sre.

support-zoe: filing customer note and scheduling the postmortem with Notos. Will share draft here before sending.

notos_oncall: thanks team. Appreciate the low-friction failover and preserving session continuity.

eng-runtime-maya: action items captured: 1) collect detailed perf traces from both regions, 2) validate driver patch correlation, 3) prepare rollback plan for us-east kernel if needed, 4) keep warm pool for 24h.

ops-coordinator-emma: closing live mitigation. We'll keep this thread pinned and update with postmortem link once ready. :white_check_mark:
